name: _root_.AffineEquiv.list_wbtw_map_iff
statement: List P} (f : P ≃ᵃ[R] P') : (l.map f).Wbtw R ↔ l.Wbtw R

name: _root_.AffineEquiv.list_sbtw_map_iff
statement: List P} (f : P ≃ᵃ[R] P') : (l.map f).Sbtw R ↔ l.Sbtw R

name: exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_wbtw
statement: List P} (hl : l ≠ []) : (∃ l' : List R, l'.SortedLE ∧ l'.map (lineMap (l.head hl) (l.getLast hl)) = l) ↔ l.Wbtw R

name: exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_sbtw
statement: List P} (hl : l ≠ []) : (∃ l' : List R, l'.SortedLT ∧ l'.map (lineMap (l.head hl) (l.getLast hl)) = l ∧ (l.length = 1 ∨ l.head hl ≠ l.getLast hl)) ↔ l.Sbtw R
